name: 39D
source:
After his brother's mysterious death, Misha and his best friend investigate 39D, a mysterious military test site. The official account leaves questions unanswered, and the complex may hold the truth. As they descend, they encounter familiar post-Soviet interiors and impossible spaces.

39D is a linear sci-fi psychological horror visual novel about loss, hope, and secrets best left undiscovered.

[Based on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5510400/39D/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在哥哥离奇身亡后，米沙与挚友一同前往调查神秘的军事试验场39D。官方通报留下了诸多未解的疑团，而这座地下设施里或许就藏着真相。随着两人不断向深处探索，熟悉的后苏联时代室内陈设与违背常理的异度空间接连浮现。

《39D》是一部线性叙事的科幻心理恐怖视觉小说，探讨失去、希望，以及那些本不该被揭开的秘密。

[整理自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5510400/39D/]Steam[/url]]
